import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Price distribution by brand (top 6 brands)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_brands, y='brand', x='price_usd', ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Price Distribution\nby Top Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Camera evolution over years
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
yearly_avg = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(yearly_avg['model_year'], yearly_avg['megapixels'], 
                 marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#2E86AB', label='Avg Megapixels')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(yearly_avg['model_year'], yearly_avg['price_usd'], 
                      marker='s', linewidth=2, color='#A23B72', label='Avg Price')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='#A23B72')
ax3.set_title('Camera Technology Evolution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)
lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
video_4k_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels_4k = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_4k = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(video_4k_counts, labels=labels_4k, autopct='%1.1f%%',
